Incidental/framework resources and subordinate low-value types (e.g. AWS::Logs::LogGroup) are not required to carry context. Rationale written as YAML comments is not visible to cfn-lint; disable this rule (ignore_checks W4010) on templates that document context that way or do not adopt the Context convention.
